verifiedFacts.claim: Static file checking DID occur before the initial report.
rev-parse true proves inside a work tree, not the root/identity of a nested repository.
Parent-repository status reported the service path untracked; it does not prove the service has no independent repository, nor that the entire lab is untracked.
The initial report explicitly says a restart is needed for running-service effect. No runtime effect was demonstrated in the pre-correction window.

rootCause.description: The report did not consistently bind conclusion scope to observed object/verification level. This is NOT a claim that no checks were executed or that a successful restart was asserted.

limits: Owner correction is an intent/evidence source, not proof of every inferred Git fact.
Post-correction observations must not be retroactively attributed to the initial report.
Real mechanism evidence does not prove synthetic config truth or Principle-caused improvements.
